name: Pass 25 structured evidence hardening
goal: Ensure certificate bundle validation and refinery pass-gate validation require structured evidence fields rather than prose mentions.
risks: Required certificate, panel, or artifact IDs could appear only in prose
A pass refinery gate could have no scoped work
A pass refinery gate could omit verdict rationale or next action

nodes.label: Pass 25 structured evidence critic review

node_contract.what: Review certificate and refinery gate evidence placement.
node_contract.why: Traceable evidence must live in structured acceptance fields.
node_contract.how: Inspect validators and runner cases for prose-only evidence bypasses.
node_contract.who: Codex using quality, governance, and verification expert lenses.
node_contract.how_good: Findings are reproducible and covered by negative fixtures.

nodes.feedback_loop: Any new bypass becomes validator logic and a hardening-runner negative fixture.
gates: bypass reproduced or reasoned from validator

nodes.label: Structured evidence validator implementation

node_contract.what: Require exact structured evidence list membership and scoped pass gates.
node_contract.why: Acceptance proof must be machine-checkable and future-reviewer-ready.
node_contract.how: Add YAML list extraction helpers, update certificate/gate validators, sync workspace, and add negative fixtures.
node_contract.where: df-quality-refinery installed skill and workspace bundle.
node_contract.when: After critic review and before evidence closure.
node_contract.how_good: Positive fixtures pass and prose-only evidence plus empty-scope pass gates fail.

nodes.feedback_loop: Rerun the full hardening suite after every validator change.

nodes.label: Pass 25 verification sweep

node_contract.why: The structured-evidence hardening only counts if the full suite and merged records pass.
node_contract.how: Run hardening suite, merged-record validation, hash sync, JSON, ASCII, and artifact ID checks.
node_contract.where: Workspace validation suite and pass 25 records.
node_contract.when: After all fixes and records are written.
node_contract.how_good: All checks pass and residual risks remain explicit.

nodes.feedback_loop: Any failed check reopens the fix node.
